hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — K, Q. You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Turn — 5. You bet again. Your opponent raised you.

wrongReasons: 8 3 has similar strength, but look at when the aggression shifted — the turn card connects with the correct hand in a way it doesn't connect with 8 3.
Q 8 doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only two pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
6 J doesn't benefit from the turn card the way the correct hand does. A player holding only two pair wouldn't have the confidence to raise on that street.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 3 2

Your opponent flopped a full house and slow-played the flop, calling to disguise their strength. Once the pot was big enough they raised the turn and shoved the river — a classic trap with a monster hand.
